comparison.objective: Align and cut a card to width on a guillotine while keeping the free gripper clear of the blade; candidate adjusts, locks, and functionally verifies a robot-gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1135 tests planar card alignment, holding material flat, guarded handle operation, and hazard-zone avoidance; candidate tests precision rotary tool seating, bimanual countertorque, locknut tightening, and test-lever actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1135 requires an 8 cm cut within 5 mm, blade down, released card, safe hand clearance, and stillness; candidate requires retained angular accuracy through three cycles, nut retention, tool withdrawal, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Neither the physical mechanism nor the graded ability overlaps beyond generic bimanual manipulation; all available versions state the cutting proxy, real-bench measurement, safety revocation, partial credit, and dwell details.
